ordering.measurementNote: round-4 hardening retained: (ADAPTER) iteration selection + per-iteration validation live in the trusted parent, never in a candidate-authored completion file — the parent draws a fresh per-sample nonce, drives both the candidate and the pristine /opt/target-seed reference with it, and each folds every timed iteration's protected probe observations into a nonce-keyed proof returned over the parent-owned stdout pipe; a sample counts only when the candidate proof equals the reference proof for that nonce, so a process that computed the base once and exited cannot be credited. (EST, round-6) score = manifest qBase anchor * geomean over workloads of the MEDIAN per-pair reference/candidate wall-time ratio over 30 strictly alternating fresh-process legs (candidate+reference legs in one batch run back-to-back against the same instantaneous host load, so common-mode contention cancels within the pair; the median rejects pairs where a contention burst hit only one leg), with a frozen per-file repetition table calibrated so every timed leg is ~0.6s of work, equalizing each workload's exposure to load (the previous global per-mode repetitions left the recovery workloads' legs at ~0.1-0.25s, disproportionately noisy under load). (NS) every timed leg runs in a fresh mount+IPC namespace with a brand-new /tmp, /dev/shm and /var/tmp; the untimed warmup uses a distinct nonce so it cannot satisfy a scored leg. (CG) peak RSS is the whole-tree kernel cgroup memory.peak. Between legs the evaluator (a subreaper) reaps every candidate-uid process and drains the measurement leaf. Round-6: the scored corpus adds train/validation recovery.css (malformed/recovery CSS + formatter edge constructs), timed and proof-bound identically to every other workload.
